full_page.content:
1928, March
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 4.
Page 18 Cont.
Mother to have serious operation To-day - 3 small children. Pneumonia & Spinal Meningitis - 6 yrs. old.
Mrs. Sara Fox - 3 children - fears operation.
Mrs. Mathing 23 - 2 children - doctors say she has Tuberculosis now down sick - asks prayers
Gilbert Natchka - 3606 E. Warren $4000.00 in four years - only five now - 75 convultions last Saturday. Operation next Tuesday in Providence Hospital.
Heart Trouble & Asthma very sick
Page 19
Rose - Mrs. Rose - Woman
Mrs. Kelleher - 608 McDougal - cancer case
Anna Morgan 4299 Mt. Elliott hip trouble & terribly large neck cured - ankle 18 inches & whole leg was black - neck was 28 in. circum. O.K.
Frances Besser - Simple - wayword - Enrolled - started back to church on Good Friday.
Mrs. Laura Ruen - 52 - 3 children 12, 9, & 3 - Cancer coming back after operation three years ago.
Miss Kurth
Mrs. Sharer (19) 4453 Concord - hopelessly Tuburcular, husband asks for prayers.
April 24 Dolores Casper - 22 yrs old - pneumonia & Spinalmeningitis - two weeks unconscious before going to hospital - still unconscious two weeks more - 4 hours to li. - (live)
Saunders - work -
Cleaveland - Rhum. - weak heart.
